scope: offline source inspection and strictly fake preflight, not any live Supabase data

observations.detail: GET /rest/v1/erp_states selects data, updated_at, sync_version and other metadata scoped by user_id. data is treated as state snapshot via snapshotInfo(). The code path does not expose a trusted single-billing public PDF query.
RPC erp_state_cas_write_v2 accepts new_data for state CAS writes; never call this in PDF exporter.

Frontend requires aal2 and queries company_members, companies, erp_company_states metadata. Browser canView billings depends on owner/admin/accounting. Role/identity must be verified independently server-side for PDF handoff.
Browser decodes JWT payload to decide aal for UI; decoding is NOT cryptographic verification for a new PDF server.

Builds external-billing-print-v1 client payload from saved grouped document, and template from local Store; navigation via URL fragment to external-billing-print.html. This is not a trusted network endpoint.
No live schema, RLS policies, actual data or authorized per-document table/view/RPC were queried. A per-document API may exist outside inspected files, but its security is unproven.

requirements: Only request locator documentType/documentId/targetBillingId/expectedRevision; no client-supplied company, posted ERP snapshot or public view as trusted input

Cryptographically validate real access token on trusted server; verify issuer, audience, expiry and session revocation as appropriate; require aal2 and company active membership and billings permission
Do not authorize from user_metadata or from a decoded but unverified JWT; never expose service_role or secret key to browser
Trusted data source MUST demonstrate only a single billing document returned, scoped by company/user, target billing and expected revision; enforce RLS and test cross-company/IDOR
Do not use existing erp_states full data snapshot API or frontend company metadata lookup as substitute for single-document authorized business data
Preserve authoritative original construction rows and approved totals; never mutate or reprice original bills for PDF
Public allowlist strips original invoice numbers, other regions, salary, bank, snapshots, payroll, auth and employee data
Old browser File Print/window.print bypasses cannot be blocked by a host PDF gate; must be separately documented and migrated or marked unsupported
Every actual exported PDF must be validated by PDF bytes and exactly the same bytes delivered under a scoped one-use ticket
No live schema migration, RLS change, Edge Function, production URL or database query without fresh explicit authorization and proven recoverability

blockers.description: Trusted production single-document source not established; current observed cloud sync reads erp_states.data snapshot
Server-side JWT/MFA/company permission validation not implemented or tested against actual source
No verified server-to-document company/target/revision authorization and RLS/IDOR tests
No real SYNCED or current safe restorable complete backup verification
No actual corporate logo/seal, physical mobile/desktop or full account/invoice/discount/retention acceptance
Existing native print routes remain; production exact-bytes handoff not wired
Owner has not separately authorized any production deployment

next_decision: STOP any production backend. If approved separately, first inspect only live schema/RLS/function metadata read-only with scoped credentials and no business rows or personal data; independently prove a per-document source before developing a real PDF service.
